    Coverage of the vertex spaces by half-word intervals #

    Every nonzero m ∈ M_v lies in h⁺ but not in h⁻ for some half-word h at (v, s): extend the empty word by the direct continuation while m ∉ E⁺ and by the inverse continuation while m ∈ E⁻, keeping m ∈ E^* M and m ∉ E^* 0. The process stops at a finite word or defines an infinite one.
